The radio may be equipped with a radio as an option.

The system consists of the following parts:

- radio (CD/tape player);

- radio supply leads;

- two front speakers located on the doors and two on the facia;

- two rear speakers;

- cables connecting the radio with the speakers;

- aerial;

- Subwoofer;

- coaxial aerial lead.

The Subwoofer is combined with the top range radio system.

This system emphasises the bass frequencies to extend and complement the sound reproduction in an optimal manner.

The radio system is equipped with a communication protocol with an electronic unit that manages the electrical system (body computer).

When the radio is supplied, the body computer reads the radio code and determines whether to activate it or not.

The radio circuit is supplied with the key ON and via a direct supply from the battery (which allows tuning, safety codes, etc. to be stored).

The two supply lines are protected by three circuits of which two in the under-dashboard junction unit and a third in the junction unit in the engine compartment.
